algorithms.name: 30s Opening Ramp
algorithms.formula: 30s buckets, first-fire gate at 2m, trailing wall baseline up to 8m.
algorithms.rationale: Basketball-specific shorter window; tests whether 60s is too slow.

algorithms.name: 12 Game Min + Recent 4 Wall Min
algorithms.formula: baseline = game-clock 12m robust scale blended with 1.5x recent wall 4m robust scale.
algorithms.rationale: Directly tests game minutes versus timeout/wall-clock stress.

algorithms.name: 6 Game Min Fast Memory
algorithms.formula: I_t versus robust baseline over the prior six game-clock minutes.
algorithms.rationale: Tests the user's view that basketball memory should be much shorter.

algorithms.name: 4 Wall Min Timeout-Sensitive
algorithms.formula: I_t versus robust baseline over prior four wall-clock minutes.
algorithms.rationale: Lets timeout/stoppage betting pressure alter the baseline quickly.

algorithms.name: Final 5 Close Suppressed
algorithms.formula: A04, but multiply threshold by 1.75 in final five minutes when margin <= 5.
algorithms.rationale: Explicit false-alarm control for normal clutch volatility.

algorithms.name: Final 60s Foul-Game Suppressed
algorithms.formula: A04 with stronger threshold in final 60s when margin <= 3.
algorithms.rationale: Separates intentional-foul chaos from true stat-misallocation risk.
citations: Performance under pressure free throw literature

algorithms.name: Volume-Heavy Short Memory
algorithms.formula: sum(|Δlogit(p)| * log1p(volume)^1.5) over 30s, six-minute wall baseline.
algorithms.rationale: Less time memory, more weight on actual wager/volume magnitude.

algorithms.name: Off-Price Concentration
algorithms.formula: severity = volumeShare * offPriceDistance * spread/depth stress.
algorithms.rationale: Single-print detector extended with volume share and depth/spread stress.

algorithms.name: Off-Price Fanout Required
algorithms.formula: A10, but require off-price activity in at least two source markets in the bucket.
algorithms.rationale: Prevents one isolated print from suspending a game.

algorithms.name: Board Fanout Range Required
algorithms.formula: A04, but require at least three markets and two families to move.
algorithms.rationale: No single market can take out the detector by itself.

algorithms.name: Cross-Source Confirmed
algorithms.formula: A04, but require at least two sources to contribute inside the bucket.
algorithms.rationale: Suppresses single-venue noise while preserving cross-venue repricing.

algorithms.name: Gap-Decay EWMA
algorithms.formula: z_t = (x_t - μ_t) / σ_t with α = exp(-Δt / τ), τ = 6 wall minutes.
algorithms.rationale: Handles uneven sparse ticks without pretending samples are evenly spaced.

algorithms.name: CUSUM Regime Shift
algorithms.formula: C_t = max(0, C_{t-1} + robust_z_t - drift), alarm when C_t > h.
algorithms.rationale: Finds starts of sustained repricing regimes, not only one tall bucket.

algorithms.name: RV/BV Jump Split
algorithms.formula: Require robust high x_t and current squared move / bipower variation > 2.25.
algorithms.rationale: Separates one ugly print from broad repricing.

algorithms.name: Clutch HAR + Fanout
algorithms.formula: Hybrid board + off-price stress, HAR-like memory, late-game threshold lift, fanout >= 2.
algorithms.rationale: Most NBA-specific all-in contestant for final-minute false-alarm control.

algorithms.name: Last-5 Home/Away Prior Ramp
algorithms.formula: prior = 50% last five away-team away openings + 50% last five home-team home openings; share fades to zero by 12 game minutes.
algorithms.rationale: Tests the real deployable historical-prior profile instead of making the first few minutes depend only on current-game noise.

algorithms.name: Historical Prior + Fanout Guard
algorithms.formula: A18 with at least three moving markets and two market families in the 30s bucket.
algorithms.rationale: Keeps the historical opening prior, but refuses to let one market or family carry the alarm by itself.

algorithms.name: Coverage-Normalized Historical Prior
algorithms.formula: A19, but board intensity is divided by sqrt(active moving markets) before the robust baseline.
algorithms.rationale: Tests whether 300-fire games are partly listed-market breadth artifacts rather than true per-market volatility.

algorithms.name: Historical Prior + Fanout + Cooldown
algorithms.formula: A19, plus one fire can suppress the next four 30s buckets so a regime shift does not page every bucket.
algorithms.rationale: Tests alert-hygiene hysteresis separately from the underlying volatility score.
